title: Implement generate_cook_membrane_mesh() trapezoidal mesh generator
objective: Add a trapezoidal mesh generator for Cook's membrane geometry (left height=44mm, right height=16mm, length=48mm) to mesh_io.py using coordinate warping of a structured hex mesh.

plan_assets.asset_description: Cook's membrane geometry and y-coordinate warping formula

scope: Add generate_cook_membrane_mesh(nx, ny, nz) -> HexMesh to mesh_io.py
Geometry: x in [0,48], left height 44, right height 16, thickness z in [0,1]
Boundary tags: x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1
implementation_steps: Read existing generate_hex8_mesh in mesh_io.py for patterns
Implement generate_cook_membrane_mesh using structured mesh + y-warping
Generate rectangular mesh on [0,48]x[0,44]x[0,1] then warp y-coordinates
Tag boundaries: x0 (fixed), x1 (loaded), y0, y1, z0, z1
deliverables: Function returns HexMesh with correct trapezoidal geometry and boundary tags
acceptance_criteria: Boundary tags correctly identify all 6 faces

cases: Verify corner coordinates match trapezoidal geometry

risks: Coordinate warping may produce negative Jacobians for very coarse meshes with extreme taper. Mitigation: use reasonable mesh density (nx >= 4).
completion_notes: Boundary tags detected pre-warp for correct y1 identification. Warping formula verified: h(x)=44-28x/48 strictly positive, no Jacobian inversion risk.
